PUBLIC SERVICES COMMITTEE
MINUTES

‘A meeting of the Public Services Committee was held on Tuesday, August 8, 2023, in Committee
Room 104 and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Bryan Cook, Chairman, Pete Laybourn, Dr. Rinne (via Zoom) and
Tom Segrave.

AGENDA ITEMS

7. ORDINANCE ~3 READING — Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
Cheyenne changing the zoning classification from HI Heavy Industrial, AG Agricultural
and County A-2 to LI Light Industrial for land located west of Burlington Trail and south
of and adjacent to HR Ranch Road.

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 3% and final reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Motion
carried by unanimous voice vote.

Connor White, Planning & Development Department, provided a staff report and Brad Emmons,
AVIP.C., was available for questions.

9. ORDINANCE -2" READING — Creating Section 2.08.060, City Employees and
Immediate Family Members; Conflict of Interest Policy, of Chapter 2.08, City Officers and
Employees Generally, of Title 2, Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of
the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, requiring the promulgation of a Conflict of Interest Policy
for employees of the City of Cheyenne as specified and making a conforming amendment
to Section 2.52.010, Regulations and Benefits, (SPONSORS - MR. COOK, MR.
JOHNSON, DR. RINNE AND MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2nd reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn, Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

Stefanie Boster, City Attomey, provided a staff report and public comment was made by Seth
Lloyd.

10. ORDINANCE ~2™ READING — Creating a new Section 15.50.070, Neglected Structure,
of Chapter 15.50, Historic Design Guideline, of Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of
the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming. (SPONSOR — MR. JOHNSON)

Dr. Rinne moved to approve on 2™ reading, seconded by Mr. Laybourn. Dr. Rinne moved to
postpone until the August 28, 2023, meeting of the governing body. Motion to postpone died due
to the lack ofa second. Main motion failed with Mr. Laybourn and Mr. Segrave voting “NO” and
Dr. Rinne voting “YES”.
